result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major content/data bug showing an invalid delivery price, plus two minor visual inconsistencies in layout and styling.

issues.description: The restaurant 'Smash Bros Burgers' displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid numeric delivery price, indicating a data formatting or missing-value bug.
issues.suggestion: Fix the price formatting logic to render a valid numeric value (e.g., '€0.00', '€1.50') or show '€0 delivery' for free delivery; add fallback handling for null/undefined prices.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is partially cut off on the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding or peek spacing to the carousel so partially visible cards clearly indicate scrollability without clipping text or looking broken.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons are visually inconsistent: the ramen card uses a transparent heart while the pizza card uses a heart on a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent visual style.
